scope: Bounded complete 5v5 PPO updates with rollout, Elo evaluation, GAE, four PPO epochs, optimizer, and logging

configuration.policies: randomly initialized live/average policy stack; no trained checkpoint loaded

command_template: flock -x artifacts/deadline-experiment/benchmark.lock timeout 15m .venv/bin/python -u benchmarks/rl_pipeline_profile.py --profile rl --override num_steps=8 --override num_minibatches=4 --override logical_batch_tokens=6656 --override launch.rollout_tokens=6656 --updates 3 --warmup 1 --timing wall --compile default --perception {eager|default} --no-checkpoint --checkpoint-dir /tmp/bnb-extension-checkpoints --out <arm.json> --label <arm>
decision: keep as the default PPO perception path: the targeted primary env+net phase improved in every pair, environment-only throughput improved strongly, and parity passed; complete update throughput was effectively neutral in this short run because Elo and PPO optimization dominate
limitations: Only 32 environments and eight rollout steps were used so the bounded experiment could finish.
Three updates per arm do not establish long-run tail behavior.
Warmup values are cache/order dependent and are reported, not compared as steady-state throughput.
This does not predict the exact gain at the production 960-environment, 128-step logical batch.
